summary.text: Soñia Galaviz represents Idaho House District 16, Seat A, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Galaviz was born and raised in the Silver Valley and has been a public school teacher for more than 20 years.
It lists an Ed.D. in curriculum and instruction with a STEM education emphasis from Boise State University (2020).

sources.title: Idaho House of Representatives membership directory (2026 session)
